messages:
alex: Heads-up — starting final prep to ingest selene-13b-v1 into staging. weights are on S3 but legal flagged license + tokenizer quirks. tagging @mira @sarah-legal for visibility.

mira: thanks. can you paste the exact S3 path and manifest you plan to use? also any checksum?

alex: path: s3://redwood-models/selene/13b/v1/weights/
manifest: s3://redwood-models/selene/13b/v1/manifest.json
sha256: 3b7f2a9c2e8f4b1d9e2f... (full in the manifest)

alex: ingest command i'm going to run:```
redwoodctl ingest --source s3://redwood-models/selene/13b/v1/ --manifest manifest.json --env staging
```

devon: quick infra note — the model config has position_embeddings = 8192 in the repo but the runtime config expects 4096. validator will fail unless we set override max_seq 4096 or recompile.

mira: ugh. that's the tokenizer issue i mentioned earlier: selene tokenizer outputs longer sequences when byte-fusion enabled. default tokenization sometimes produces a leading <BOS> token id=2 that we haven't normalized.

mira: sample tokenizer quirk: tokens sometimes include two consecutive BOS tokens when input starts with special marker; this pushes length +1 unpredictable.

alex: ok — plan: run tokenizer normalizer to strip extra BOS, then run a quick pass to clip sequences >4096. will add a pre-ingest hook to the manifest.

alex: pre-ingest snippet I'll add to manifest:```
"preprocessing": [
  {"cmd": "tokenizer-normalize --strip-bos"},
  {"cmd": "clip-seq --max-len 4096"}
]
```

devon: that should unblock the runtime validator. please also attach the model's config.json we will ship to runtime (so ops can stage kernels).

alex: attaching config excerpt in thread:```
{"model_type": "transformer","d_model": 8192,"num_layers": 40,"position_embeddings": 4096}
```

ops: @alex @devon note — if d_model = 8192 we need the xformers optimized kernels built for that width. ops needs ~24h to spin a test instance with patched kernel. can you mark this as 'needs-kernel-test' in the rollout metadata?

alex: done. added rollout_metadata: ["needs-kernel-test","staging-only","no-burst"] to manifest.

sarah-legal: quick legal / licensing note — selene-13b-v1 is flagged as CC-BY-NC-4.0 variant with an attribution requirement and a non-commercial restriction. we need the following before production: model_card.md in root, a provenance.json that lists dataset sources, and a clear attribution snippet to return in responses when requested.

sarah-legal: suggested attribution text (short):
"Model: Selene-13B v1 — creators: SeleneAI Lab. Licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0. Commercial use prohibited without separate license from SeleneAI."

mira: can legal confirm whether 'internal product demos' count as non-commercial? product team will want to demo to prospects.

sarah-legal: internal demos to prospective customers are commercial if shown outside a contract-free evaluation. short version: ask sales for a restricted demo clause or request a commercial license from upstream.

devon: ops — from infra side we also require a lightweight provenance envelope in onboarding metadata so we can surface it in the Console. format we need: provenance.json with keys ["model_name","license","weights_sha256","provenance_url"].

alex: i'll generate provenance.json and link to model_card.md PR. pulling together dataset attributions now.

ingest-bot: validation: FAILED — config position_embeddings (4096) != weights position_embeddings (8192).

devon: ingest-bot is right. two paths: 1) convert weights to 4096 position embeddings (tricky, risky) 2) recompile runtime to accept 8192 and test kernels. given this model's size i'd prefer option 2.

ops: option 2 timeline: build + deploy test kernel image ~24-36h, plus perf smoke tests. can do in staging.

alex: leaning option 2. i'll also add a short note in model_card that sequence length is effectively 4096 for safe defaults, with ops note about 8192-capable kernel.

mira: one more tokenizer edge: token-id mapping for unk differs (selene uses unk_id=0, our standard is 3). add mapping table to manifest:```
"token_map": {"unk": 0, "bos": 2, "eos": 1} 
```

alex: added token_map and provenance reference. pushing manifest -> PR: https://git.internal/redwood/models/selene/13b/PR-482

sarah-legal: confirm PR includes model_card.md and provenance.json + the license text. once i review i'll stamp "legal-cleared-staging". :white_check_mark:

mira: i'll run a quick tokenization smoke test on the staging subset after you push. ping me when PR is merged.

alex: PR merged. pinging @mira to start smoke tests.

mira: kicked off smoke tests. first 50 examples done, two cases still show double-BOS. i'll post details in the PR thread.

devon: thanks. once smoke tests pass we'll kick off ops kernel build. keep legal looped for the card + attribution text.

sarah-legal: received. if smoke tests are green i'll pre-approve staging for a 7-day eval window under NON-COMMERCIAL clause. we need to capture any user-visible attribution prompts in evals.

alex: sounds good. marking thread as tracking: [manifest-ready,legal-onboarded,tokenizer-smoke,ops-kernel]. will report back after kernel build starts. :rocket:
